params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: After closing a Mollie payment without paying and cancelling the transport, a garage was told that "a paid transport can no longer be cancelled", while the transport was in fact cancelled and nothing was paid. The message is wrong and alarming for a garage trying transport for the first time.

Source: Portal mail:7 (follow-up from the platform on 9 October 2026).

What the garage did: requested a transport, went to the payment screen, closed the payment without paying, and cancelled. It got the "paid transport" refusal, yet the transport shows as cancelled.

Cause, from the code:
- A cancel in the transport window (`_modal/show_footer.blade.php`) only hides the window. The list behind it keeps offering "Aanvraag annuleren" for the request that was just cancelled.
- Cancelling again from there reaches `TransportController::cancel` for a cancelled transport. `isCancellable()` is false, and the only refusal message is `transport.cannot_cancel_after_payment`.
- The first cancel did ask Mollie first and only cancelled because the payment was not paid, so the state is right; only the answer and the stale screen are wrong.

Related, same path: `TransportController::returned` sends a cancelled transport back to "being processed" (`?processing=`), and the overview then polls and comes back every three seconds.

Expected: cancelling a cancelled transport answers yes; the page shows the new state after a cancel in the window; a refused cancel says why; back from Mollie, a cancelled transport says it is cancelled and nothing was charged.
params.title: Cancelling a transport after a closed payment says it was paid
